exceptions.title: Critical aged inventory: Womens Wear Rs.186 Cr (>90 days)
exceptions.impact: Rs.186 Cr tied in 275K articles >90 days across Womens Wear

cascadeChain.description: 275K articles aged >90 days, representing 29.6% of Womens Wear inventory value
Markdown pressure building: 41K SKUs require immediate liquidation action
GM erosion: Womens Wear GM down 2.8 pts QoQ due to increased aged stock
Working capital lock: Rs.186 Cr inventory not generating returns

recommendations.action: Execute liquidation markdown on 41K SKUs — graduated discount 30-60% based on age
Redistribute 18K fast-selling units to Tier-1 stores to improve turnover
Pause Contemporary POs worth Rs.12 Cr until aged stock clears below 20% threshold
